title: Pinout connector definition
description: An evaluated connector Jsonnet object. Its ID defaults to its filename stem.
$comment: Pin numbers must be from starting_num to starting_num + dimensions.width * dimensions.height - 1; the program checks these dynamic bounds. Object keys make pin numbers unique.

starting_num.description: First displayed pin number. Defaults to 1 in a base definition; an omitted override inherits the base value. Changing it in an override shifts inherited pin keys before merging the override's absolute-numbered keys. Literal names, colors, and GPIO labels are not rewritten.

id.description: Unique connector ID. When omitted from a base definition, the loader uses its filename without .jsonnet.

name.description: Connector name printed as the pinout header.

pins.description: Optional definitions keyed by canonical positive displayed pin-number strings, within the range selected by starting_num and dimensions. Pins without definitions have no label. Overrides merge each pin's fields after any inherited-key shift.

name.description: Fixed label, subject to GPIO matching when gpiod_label is non-null.

missing.description: Physically absent pin. True leaves its layout position blank, without a number or label, and does not renumber other pins.

color.description: Console foreground color for the pin label and number.

gpiod_label.description: Exact GPIO line name required for a label. A match uses name if defined, otherwise this value. Null disables GPIO matching, including an inherited requirement.

override.description: Resolve id to a base connector, recursively merge objects, and replace scalar values. The resolved connector must satisfy the complete connector schema.
